name: Love Song for Narain
summary: Meridith sends her love to Narain Soothfancy, and you carry her letter to him in Tanaris. She rescued the gnome from a crashed flying machine and asks you to seek his book, Draconic for Dummies.

sections.title: A Message for the Shore
sections.body: Meridith the Mermaiden seldom has visitors. Her last was the gnome she rescued from a crashed flying machine. The memory takes her gaze far away for a moment. Then she asks if you know Narain Soothfancy. She needs to tell him how she feels, and she is sure it is love. Meridith begs you to carry her message to him and promises to be forever in your debt.

sections.title: Narain's Answer
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy says you smell of fish. When he learns what Meridith's letter says, he fidgets. She is a fish, he protests, and he is a gnome. He insists their love could never work out.

faq.answer: Meridith is a mermaiden who seldom has visitors. Her last visitor was Narain Soothfancy, the gnome she rescued from a crashed flying machine.

faq.q: How does Meridith know Narain Soothfancy?
faq.answer: Meridith rescued Narain Soothfancy from his crashed flying machine. She believes she is in love with him.
The love letter is Meridith's message to Narain Soothfancy, telling him how she feels. She wants you to deliver it to him in Tanaris.

aliases: prerequisite for love song for narain
faq.answer: Draconic for Dummies comes first. Meridith asks you to carry her letter while you seek Narain's buried book.
